Spectacular West Lake Views & Delicious Dining at Café du Lac
Aug 2024 • Solo
Café du Lac at InterContinental Hanoi Westlake offers one of the most serene dining experiences I’ve had. Overlooking the peaceful waters of West Lake, the restaurant truly feels like you’re floating on the water with sweeping lakeside views — especially beautiful during breakfast.

The breakfast buffet is outstanding: a rich selection ranging from freshly baked pastries, tropical fruits, made-to-order omelets, classic pho, and an Asian noodle station that’s superb. A guest review perfectly captured it as a “lovely dining room with multiple stations offering anything you might want”

Great for breakfast if you're staying.
Jan 2023
My wife and I had a few great breakfasts here. The cook making the morning Pho was legendary. My wife usually asks for chili to spice up any meal and she was not disappointed with this one. Chefs all round are excellent, great scrambled eggs etc. Coffee was great. A very wide range of food from local to Japanese to Korean to Indonesian to Western. Easy to have a great feed, with lots of health options too. Good staff.
